messages:
ryan: Quick heads-up	I'm doing a small sync to make streaming + pagination + retry snippets consistent across py/ts/go. Found three variants in quickstarts and migration notes. Draft will include tiny helpers so teams can copy-paste.

mina: Love it. Can we standardize on an opaque `cursor` field (string) and show a clean client-side loop for each language? Also call out: do not parse the cursor.

oliver: Agreed. Suggestions: Python -> `async for` with resume token example; TS -> both `for await` and `getReader()` patterns + compact retry helper; Go -> bufio.Scanner streaming + light backoff. Keep snippets <= 20 lines.

tia: For retries let's show a minimal helper (no deps). Example TS helper I'm thinking: 

```ts
async function retry<T>(fn: ()=>Promise<T>, attempts=3){
  for(let i=0;i<attempts;i++){
    try{return await fn()}catch(e){ if(i===attempts-1) throw e; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100*(i+1))) }
  }
}
```

ryan: Nice. Python streaming snippet (resume-aware): 

```py
last_token = None
async for part in client.chat.stream(prompt, resume_from=last_token):
    print(part.text)
    if getattr(part, 'id', None):
        last_token = part.id
```

mina: For TS, show chunk accumulation when chunks contain partial JSON (common ask): 

```ts
let buf = ''
for await (const chunk of client.chat.stream({model, input})){
  buf += chunk.text
  try { const obj = JSON.parse(buf); handle(obj); buf = '' } catch(e){ /* wait for more */ }
}
```

oliver: Go sample (SSE-style): 

```go
scanner := bufio.NewScanner(resp.Body)
for scanner.Scan() {
  line := scanner.Text()
  handle(line)
}
if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil { /* retry/backoff */ }
```

ryan: I'll open the PR and include a migration blurb about cursor vs page tokens and an "If you see missing items" section recommending a short refresh window or re-fetch using timestamps. Also add a backport checklist for archived quickstarts.

docs-bot: PR draft created by ryan: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3612  labels: docs, sdk-examples

mina: I'll review once it's up. Small nit: call the pagination field `cursor` in examples but list legacy aliases in the migration note (`cursor_token`, `page_token`).

oliver: I'll sanity-check the Go snippet and the context cancellation pattern. If OK, can we merge and backport? Some customers still use the legacy quickstarts.

ryan: Will request reviews from @mina and @oliver and add the backport steps in the PR checklist. Thanks all :v:
